stories.title: Bloqueos de trabajadores del IMSS complican la circulación en CDMX; estas son las alternativas viales

en.title: IMSS worker blockades complicate traffic circulation in CDMX; these are the road alternatives
en.summary: Workers blocked several major avenues in Mexico City including Fortuna Avenue and Instituto Politécnico Nacional Avenue, as well as Cuauhtémoc and Baja California, disrupting traffic flow in the capital.

stories.title: Puerto Vallarta retoma actividades tras el paso de "Simon"; navegación continúa suspendida en Jalisco

en.title: Puerto Vallarta resumes activities after "Simon" passes; navigation remains suspended in Jalisco
en.summary: Puerto Vallarta gradually resumed normal urban activity after restrictions were lifted following the passage of a storm, though maritime navigation remained suspended in Jalisco.

stories.title: Trabajadores del IMSS bloquean vialidades en CDMX previo a marcha nacional; presionan por mejoras laborales

en.title: IMSS workers block roadways in CDMX ahead of national march; press for labor improvements
en.summary: IMSS workers blocked at least two zones in Mexico City to pressure for labor improvements as they prepared for a national march.

stories.title: Huracán Simon y tormenta tropical Rachel dejan saldo de al menos cinco muertos en México

en.title: Hurricane Simon and tropical storm Rachel leave at least five dead in Mexico
en.summary: Hurricane Simon and tropical storm Rachel caused at least five deaths in Mexico, with authorities in Baja California finding four bodies including two minors in the Ensenada area.

stories.title: Nuevo sismo, de magnitud 6.1, sacude Panamá; no hay reporte de víctimas

en.title: New 6.1 magnitude earthquake shakes Panama; no victims reported
en.summary: A 6.1 magnitude earthquake struck Panama, with over 400 aftershocks recorded. Seismic activity was felt as far as neighboring Costa Rica.

stories.title: Tras terremoto que dejó casi 30 heridos, nuevo sismo sacude Panamá

en.title: New earthquake shakes Panama after temblor that left nearly 30 injured
en.summary: An earthquake occurred at 18:20 local time with its epicenter 18 kilometers west of Río Grande, approximately 300 kilometers from the capital near Coiba island.

stories.title: Deja 'Rachel' cuatro muertos en Ensenada; dos son niños

en.title: Hurricane Rachel leaves four dead in Ensenada; two are children
en.summary: Storm Rachel caused at least four deaths in Ensenada, including two children, while 32 people were rescued by air and search efforts continued.

stories.title: Angélica Rivera se une a Netflix para llevar su vida a la pantalla; será interpretada por su hija Sofía

en.title: Angélica Rivera joins Netflix to bring her life to screen; will be portrayed by her daughter Sofía
en.summary: Angélica Rivera is developing a biographical series for Netflix featuring her daughter Sofía in the lead role, produced by the creators of Luis Miguel, la serie.

stories.title: Simon, a Category 2 hurricane, churns up the Pacific coast, heading for Puerto Vallarta

en.title: Simon, a Category 2 hurricane, churns up the Pacific coast, heading for Puerto Vallarta
en.summary: Hurricane Simon is bringing heavy rains and strong winds to several Mexican Pacific states and may intensify before making landfall on Wednesday.

stories.title: Liberan trabajadores del IMSS tres vialidades en CDMX

en.title: IMSS workers free three roadways in CDMX
en.summary: After approximately five hours, IMSS personnel cleared three of six roadways they had blocked, according to Mexico City security authorities.

stories.title: Contará Angélica Rivera su vida en una serie de Netflix

en.title: Angélica Rivera will tell her life story in a Netflix series
en.summary: Actress Angélica Rivera's life will be adapted into an autobiographical Netflix series starring her daughter Sofía Castro, releasing in 2027.

stories.title: Tormenta Rachel deja 2 muertos y 11 desaparecidos a su paso por BC

en.title: Tropical Storm Rachel leaves 2 dead and 11 missing in its passage through BC
en.summary: Tropical Storm Rachel caused two deaths and eleven disappearances in Baja California, along with collapsed utility poles, flooded neighborhoods, and damaged infrastructure.

stories.title: Hospitales y laboratorios deben involucrarse en discusión de crisis de seguros de gastos médicos: AMIS

en.title: Hospitals and laboratories should be involved in discussion of medical expense insurance crisis: AMIS
en.summary: The head of AMIS stated that the industry has been working closely with legislators to exchange views on initiatives aimed at influencing the medical insurance market.

stories.title: ¿Por qué la Tiendas 3B de Polanco luce tan distinta a la de la colonia Guerrero? Las claves del negocio

en.title: Why does the Tiendas 3B in Polanco look so different from the one in Colonia Guerrero? The keys to the business
en.summary: Different locations of the discount chain maintain varying facades while preserving competitive pricing typical of hard discount retailers.

stories.title: La IA cambia la forma de planear viajes, pero las empresas turísticas no logran seguirle el ritmo

en.title: AI changes the way people plan trips, but tourism companies cannot keep up
en.summary: Travelers use artificial intelligence to research destinations and plan vacations, yet tourism sector companies struggle with outdated systems that limit their competitiveness.

stories.title: ¿Quién es el dueño de Kiwo, la marca de autos eléctricos chinos que vende Waldo’s y competirá con Olinia?

en.title: Who owns Kiwo, the Chinese electric vehicle brand sold by Waldo's and will compete with Olinia?
en.summary: Kiwo sells electric vehicles starting at 79,999 pesos through multiple distribution channels, including a relationship with Waldo's, and will compete against the Olinia project.

stories.title: Empresas cumplen con pagos al IMSS dice el CCE; exige mejorar la atención para trabajadores

en.title: Companies comply with IMSS payments, says CCE; demands improved care for workers
en.summary: Business leaders report that companies are meeting their obligations to Mexico's social security institute but criticize inadequate service levels, citing delayed surgeries and workers forced to purchase their own medications.
